Maya S.: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: finished the v2 routing spec draft and pushed it to Confluence. Blockers: still waiting on infra DB schema + saw a small perf regress in canary p95 (~+30ms). Today: pair with @Alex K. on rollout plan, finish spec merge after signoff. @alex_k can you take CR #452? cc @Dana P. for launch copy timing.

Alex K.: Will review CR #452 by EOD. For the p95 bump I suspect a kernel change — will try reverting the aten kernel config and run a smoke perf pass. Also thinking we should add a lightweight fallback model for degraded tails.

Chris L.: I tweaked autoscale policies for the canary (min 4 -> max 16). Ran quick load test: qps steady at 120-130. No obvious errors in logs. Pushed a prometheus rule update for p95 alert.

Sam (oncall): Noticed a spike at 03:00 UTC that looked like a client retry loop. Filed INC-987 with traces (link: https://incidents.redwood/987). Not blocking the rollout but wanted y'all to be aware.

Dana P.: Marketing needs the final spec by 9am PT to lock launch copy. If we can't hit that, tell me now so we can shift timelines.

Maya S.: Re infra schema — pinging @Lisa I. for migration window.

Alex K.: Quick note on CR #452: small naming nit, will push update. Also will draft fallback config snippet and post here shortly.

Maya S.: Checklist I'm aiming for before canary starts:
``
- merge spec (owner: Maya)
- infra migration scheduled (owner: Lisa)
- canary run (2h)
- fallback config enabled (owner: Alex)
- monitor KPIs: p95, error-rate, cost-per-token
- marketing signoff (owner: Dana)
```

Chris L.: lgtm. I'll also enable the fallback feature-flag for canary and watch for false positives in alerts.

Deploy Bot: deploy started for canary v2.1 — job 8892, ETA ~10m.

Maya S.: Thanks — if anything blocks ping me and I'll escalate. Plan to reconvene sync in #product at 12:00 PT unless someone requests earlier. :thumbsup:
